title: Buaflow eval run v1
description: One recorded run of one eval case (EV-004). The field that makes the format reproducible is caseRevision: it pins the exact revision of the case that was judged, so editing the case afterwards turns every run that claimed to pass it stale instead of leaving a passing record behind. outcome is declared and then re-derived from the per-criterion verdicts; a run whose conclusion disagrees with its own verdicts fails.

caseRevision.description: Print it with: node claude-setup/eval-harness.js --revision <case file>

commit.description: The repository revision the configuration was in when the case ran. Two runs at the same commit, case revision and model are supposed to agree; when they do not, the case is non-deterministic and the harness says so.

session.description: clean means a fresh session. continued is recorded honestly and always fails: a case that passes because the conversation already discussed it proves nothing about the configuration.

gradedBy.description: Who judged the criteria. Must differ from the case's authoredBy.

variant.description: ablation is the comparison round with the case's ablation.disable paths switched off.

verdict.description: unclear scores as a failure and is counted separately: it is a report about the criterion's wording, not about the run.

artifacts.description: Retained evidence. Paths are resolved against --root and checked for existence, the same way readiness evidence is.
